subQuests.subQuestName: Speak to the strange engineer from Fontaine

736890101.text: *sigh* This just doesn't qualify as a reproducible experiment at all. It's not that I don't want to help you, Patrice, but seriously, good luck to you here...

736890102.text: There's nothing I can do here. Might as well go find something to eat... Yes, maybe some Bamboo Shoot Soup might do!

736890103.text: Well, then you're pretty far from any place you can get some, mister!

736890105.text: Wait, who are you, and why are you here in this archon-forsaken place!? Suspicious...

736890106.text: Eh, is it really that suspicious?

736890109.text: What are you saying? We came here together, didn't we?

736890110.text: Grr, there's gotta be something Paimon can say in response... That's right! We're very suspicious indeed... But as some guy from Fontaine, isn't your presence here even more suspicious?

736890111.text: Huh. Is that how I appear to others?

736890113.text: That's right. The two of us are adventurers, so it's at least kinda normal for us to be here. But you're definitely a strange sight to see!

736890114.text: #Hmmm. Well, that does make some sense... Well met then, {NICKNAME} the adventurer. And might I have your name, flying fairy?

736890116.text: Fair enough. Then I, too, shall introduce myself. I am Anatole, an engineer from the Fontaine Research Institute.

736890117.text: I shall be plain with you: I am here at the behest of my superiors at the Institute, to conduct some research...

736890119.text: Hehe, Liyue cuisine is interesting... But I fear not. The Institute is an organization dedicated to the study of machines and energy, though I do wish that we would have a Gourmet Department. That would be a capital notion!

736890120.text: Well, I'm getting off-topic. The sum of the matter is that I have a colleague who entered the Institute at the same time as me and has been researching minerals and elemental energy.

736890121.text: Hmm. If you've been around these parts, you might have met him. His name is Patrice — would that ring any bells?
